A sensitized, armored nervous system cannot metabolize sixty minutes of trauma processing; that is a flood, not a fix. Dr. Perry's data indicates the "therapeutic window" for a dysregulated brain is often only seconds long.
applied.new: The Anti-Breakthrough (Micro-Dosing): A brain stuck in alarm can often take in healing work for only a few seconds at a time, Perry finds. So for now we have to give up on the hour-long breakthrough that therapy aims for, since an hour spent working on the trauma itself overwhelms an armored nervous system more than it heals it. Instead, this protocol works in doses of a few seconds, which is what I mean by micro-dosing here.

applied.old:
As you de-armor, you will feel naked and exposed. You will assume everyone can see your anxiety, which they mostly can't. Nicholas Epley, [*Mindwise*](https://www.amazon.com/Mindwise-Misunderstand-Others-Think-Believe/dp/030774356X), calls this the "Illusion of Transparency."

Your armored brain also projects the threat it feels onto neutral faces, so you will think people are judging you when they're mostly just thinking about themselves. So during this protocol, do not trust your social intuition: assume you are misreading every room, at least until your heart rate is back down to your usual resting rate, and under 90 BPM, since a racing heart means your reasoning brain is offline (see the ["Metabolic Red Line"](https://ibogaqueen.substack.com/i/181671197/a-the-metabolic-red-line) below).

As you de-armor, you will feel naked and exposed, and you will assume everyone can see your anxiety, which they mostly can't. Nicholas Epley, [*Mindwise*](https://www.amazon.com/Mindwise-Misunderstand-Others-Think-Believe/dp/030774356X), calls this the "Illusion of Transparency."

On top of that, you'll tend to think people are judging you, when really they're mostly just thinking about themselves. That's because when your brain is armored up, you project the nonsensical threat you feel onto others. So during this protocol, do not trust your social intuition: assume you are misreading every room, at least until your heart rate is back down to your usual resting rate, and under 90 BPM, since a racing heart means your reasoning brain is offline (see the ["Metabolic Red Line"](https://ibogaqueen.substack.com/i/181671197/a-the-metabolic-red-line) below).
